title: Milos version display and Course Packs fixed
details: The More screen now shows the real installed Milos version instead of an old hard-coded version label
Future Milos tools is now corrected to Evia Course Packs every time the More screen renders
The Evia Course Packs control now has a direct guarded open path so the course list still opens even if an older screen handler is present
The v2.18 offline shell includes the current UI guard so installed copies keep the version label and Course Packs section in sync
